title: Pre-PR gate receipt
description: One entry of the receipts[] array inside the run's vault state note, 02-Notes/Sessions/<TICKET>-<SUFFIX>.state.md. NEVER written to a repo-local file: a receipt in one worktree's .claude/ is invisible to the sibling worktree and the stack layer that must verify it, and dies with the checkout. SHA-bound: a receipt whose sha is not the current HEAD is stale and must be treated as absent. No valid receipt with verdict 'pass' => no PR and no merge.

baseBranch.description: Detected base branch — never hardcoded to main.

sha.description: Full HEAD SHA the gate ran against. Binds the receipt to a commit.

mergeBase.description: git merge-base HEAD origin/<baseBranch> — the diff range floor.

stackLayer.description: Stacked-PR runs only: the layer index this receipt is bound to (0 = the layer on the trunk). One receipt per layer per repo — a receipt bound to the top of a stack proves nothing about the layers below it.

attempt.description: Fix/re-run cycle number. >3 => stop and escalate to a human.

verdict.description: 'block' forbids opening a PR or merging. 'pass' requires every mandatory layer green.

layers.description: One entry per layer L0-L9. Mandatory layers (L0, L2, L4, L5, L6, L7) must be present with status pass|block — never skipped, regardless of diff size. L9 (constitution + frozen contracts) is mandatory whenever a constitution file or a frozen contract set exists, and 'not-applicable' otherwise.

status.description: 'degraded' = layer could not run for an environment reason (e.g. private registry unavailable) and MUST be disclosed in the PR body. 'not-applicable' is only legal for non-mandatory layers with an empty scope (e.g. L3 with zero changed lintable files).

command.description: Verbatim command executed. Required whenever status is pass or block.

evidence.description: Decisive output line(s) — the proof. An adjective is not evidence.

substitution.description: Recorded when a prescribed script did not exist or was mutating/watch-mode, and a real command was used instead.

counts.description: Layer-specific tallies, e.g. L6 {dangling, unresolved, unused}; L7 {must, should}; L5 {passed, total}.

ruleSources.description: Rule files actually loaded in L7, with the applyTo glob and whether it intersected the diff.

applyTo.description: Glob from frontmatter; absent/empty means repo-wide.

applied.description: false = glob matched no changed file; recorded so coverage is auditable.

blockers.description: Every 🔴. Empty array is required for verdict 'pass'.

ruleId.description: Repo rule ID when the blocker came from L7 (e.g. FR-2, DB-3, CORE-002, PKG-1).

fix.description: Concrete fix, not generic advice (repo rule RF-002/RF-003C).

notes.description: ⚠️ non-blocking findings, carried into the PR body so a reviewer spends no round-trip on them.

rationale.description: Why it is accepted rather than fixed.

siblingRepos.description: Multi-repo runs: the other repos' receipts in this change set. Aggregate verdict is 'block' if ANY sibling is 'block'.

stateNote.description: Vault-relative path of the state note holding that repo's receipt, e.g. 02-Notes/Sessions/PROJ-421-pdf-export.state.md.

receiptBlock.description: The rendered markdown receipt block, verbatim as it must be pasted into the PR description.
